name: Twig Debugger
description: Enables Twig Debugging for your website
project_description:
Enables Twig Debugging for your website. This module is very simple, small and useful for developers who can easily see which content is rendered from which twig file and suggestions to override the twigs.

When you will not have access permission for your sites folder, this module gives you the advantage of enabling Twig Debugging for your websites.

 You can configure this module at /admin/config/development/twig-debugger ,

By checking the checkbox twig debugging will be enabled on your site.

 Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g6OhzN5W4xI
